purpose: Bounded, non-authoritative GitHub compare evidence for human review of an observed deployment-drift release.
rules: Packs are generated only for review-intake-planner items in needs_review_evidence state.
GitHub compare metadata must bind the exact reviewed commit as base and exact observed deployed commit as head.
The compare relationship must be ahead with behind_by equal to zero before a normal drift evidence pack is produced.
Packs contain file paths and numeric change statistics only; raw patches and file contents are excluded.
Changed files are bounded to 300 entries and total path text is bounded.
Review-focus categories are deterministic filename/path heuristics and are not security findings.
proposedEvidence is explicitly unreviewed and cannot be supplied to candidate intake until a human records a review outcome.
A human-reviewed evidence record must be separately authored after examining the pack and any underlying code/tests needed for judgement.
nonClaims: A clean-looking file list does not prove a release is secure.
Change counts are not risk scores.
The evidence pack is not human review evidence.
The generator does not approve, reject, intake or certify a release.
